انتهجا (form VII)

# اُنْتُهِجَا (untuhijā) /un.tu.hi.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# اِنْتَهِجَا (intahijā) /in.ta.hi.d͡ʒaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
